    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where they undershoot true values.",

    "Mean reversion bias in model forecasts causes undershooting during sustained price trends.",
    "Price consolidation periods show highest forecast accuracy as volatility compresses predictions to narrow bands.",
    "Model variance increases with true outcome variance, suggesting risk uncertainty isn't fully captured in forecast parameters.",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive precedes forecast-value divergences where model remains too conservative.",
    "Underperformance accumulates gradually in model vs true outcomes, suggesting systematic bias rather than random error."
